cypher: MATCH (a:DLFile)<-[:DL_MODIFIED_FILE]-(c:DLCommit)<-[:DL_AUTHORED_COMMIT]-(d:DLDeveloper)-[:DL_AUTHORED_COMMIT]->(other:DLCommit)-[:DL_MODIFIED_FILE]->(b:DLFile) WHERE a.dataset=$dataset AND a.repo=$repo AND a.path=$path AND c<>other AND a<>b WITH b,collect(DISTINCT a.id)+collect(DISTINCT c.id)+collect(DISTINCT d.id)+collect(DISTINCT other.id) AS evidence RETURN b.path AS entity,b.path+': '+split(b.content,'\n')[0] AS fact,evidence+[b.id] AS evidence_ids ORDER BY entity LIMIT 5
